prompt: Build a REST API for sport events (name, sport, status, start_time): create, get, list with filters by status and sport, update and change status, plus a way for clients to subscribe to event updates.
follow_ups: Status transitions: inactive -> active -> finished only; finished is terminal
An event cannot be activated if its start_time is in the past
How do clients subscribe to updates (SSE / WebSocket / Kafka)?
Persistence layer and schema/indexes; tests at unit, controller and integration level

title: Navigate a drone through a city from command input
